title: Establish qualitative spectral escape for noncritical physical Rayleigh fibres
statement: For p!=0,p^2+l^2>=2, q_m=1-1/(p^2+l^2+m^2), beta_m=sqrt(q_m q_(m+1))/2. The physical wall-normal vorticity symmetrization obeys phi_s=-2pi i p J phi with these bonds. Norm<=1 excludes outside spectrum; strictly positive endpoint diagonal deficits exclude +/-1 eigenvectors; the summable interior recurrence perturbation has nondecaying oscillatory asymptotic solutions, excluding interior point spectrum. Thus RAGE gives time-average ||P_K exp(-2pi i psJ)P_N||HS^2 ->0 for all finite N,K. Finite Taylor/finite-band rational certificates and pi enclosures can dovetail to a successful rational impulse in THAT sector. O(m^-2) deficits have divergent first weighted moment, so no imported short-range quantitative uniform rate is claimed. Squire coupling, critical modes, streamwise-zero sector and full nonlinear velocity remain unpaid.
